name: robots/masato-ka__gym-soarm
title: SO-ARM100 single-arm manipulation environment (Gymnasium SoArm-v0)
intro: SO-ARM100 single-arm manipulation environment (Gymnasium SoArm-v0), adapted from masato-ka/gym-soarm. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
